material_errors.quote: 无即时供气损失→无价格影响
material_errors.reason: Future event not yet physically effective does not demonstrate no futures price effect; this categorical causal price-zero endpoint is unsupported.

Used as a reason to neutralize the news pressure/current forecast basis, rather than a separately labelled scenario. Reaction data are explicitly unavailable, so possible absorption cannot be used as established offsetting evidence. Pure conditional scenario discussion of pricing would be different.
